Public reported approximately 4 to 6 inches of standing water covering the roadway near the intersection of Brampton Avenue and Fair Road.
A weather station at the Statesboro WWTP measured 2.69 inches of rain since 3:53 pm. About 2.50 inches fell in just under an hour.
A home weather station located near the intersection of Adabelle Road and Highway 25 measured 2.67 inches of rain since 3:34 pm. About 2 inches fell in one hour.
Savannah Harbor Pilots spotted a waterspout off Bloody Point at the south end of Daufuskie Island.
